description:
Build the systems that shape how the world finds and experiences Gallup. 

 Millions of people visit Gallup.com and Gallup News every month looking for research they trust and solutions that improve their work and life. The Consumer Engagement team builds the platforms that power those experiences, from the content management system (CMS) and rendering infrastructure to the technologies that determine how Gallup appears in search engines and AI answer engines.

 As a software engineer on the Consumer Engagement team, you'll modernize the systems that deliver and surface Gallup’s content around the world. You'll build scalable software, design back-end services and solve complex engineering challenges involving performance, CMS architecture and AI-driven search while helping more people discover CliftonStrengths ® , employee engagement and Gallup's other sciences.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Develop and maintain high-performance web applications that power Gallup's public-facing digital experiences with an emphasis on scalability, accessibility and reliability

 Modernize Gallup's content platform through API-driven architecture, content modeling and CMS evolution that enables teams across the organization

 Engineer the technical foundations that improve Gallup's discoverability across search engines and emerging AI experiences

 Design back-end services, APIs and data models that support reliable content delivery and cross-platform integrations, with attention to schema integrity and query performance

 Analyze consumer engagement data using Python to identify opportunities that improve relevance, return and discoverability

 Partner with product, marketing and UX teams to deliver technical solutions that enable self-service publishing and continuous optimization

 
 What Makes You Stand Out 

 
 Web performance instincts: You think about and verify how pages load, why they slow down and what rendering strategies best serve different types of content and users.

 CMS fluency: You have worked with headless or decoupled CMS architectures and understand content modeling, API-driven delivery and migration strategies.

 Back-end engineering: You enjoy building scalable back-end services, working with data and designing reliable systems while remaining comfortable contributing across the full stack.

 Discovery orientation: You understand how search engines and AI systems consume and rank web content, and you find the intersection of engineering and discoverability compelling. 

 Collaborative ownership: You communicate clearly across disciplines, document your decisions and contribute to a team culture where engineers ask "why" before they ask "how." 

 AI fluency: You thoughtfully explore and implement ways AI can accelerate development workflows and openly share what works with the team.

 
 What You Need 

 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience, required

 At least three years of professional experience with Python or JavaScript required

 Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production full-stack web applications required

 Working knowledge of back-end development and API design that supports content delivery at scale required

 Experience operating in cloud environments and designing for performance, reliability and security required

 Familiarity with discoverability fundamentals including technical SEO, structured data and crawlability required

 Experience with data modeling, databases, schema design and query performance required

 Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering workflows required

 A commitment to working on-site at Gallup’s Omaha office at least three days per week required

 
 About Gallup 

 At Gallup, we change the world, one client at a time, through extraordinary analytics and advice on everything important facing humankind. Learn more about our work and  life at Gallup .

 Gallup offers a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and other insurance options; a fully vested 401(k) retirement savings plan with company matching; an employee stock ownership program; family-building benefits; an employee assistance program; and various reimbursements and activities that enhance our associates’ wellbeing. We also offer an estimated annual salary range of $95,000-$125,000 for this role. Salaries are based on a variety of factors, including an individual’s education, experience and skills.

 Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

 To review Gallup’s Privacy Statement, please click this link: https://www.gallup.com/privacy . This privacy policy is meant to help you understand what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can update, manage and delete your information. Your application and the information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States.
